# HexPiece 3.4.5

Your Broken Bones request for the Gura Gura no Mi's ultimate (N), built to your answers. Not tested in game yet: the build and all tests
pass, and the overlay was rendered and judged on a phone-shaped screen (a preview, not the game).

**When the Gura ultimate (N) hits**
- Everyone it hits (players and mobs; never you) is stunned and knocked down as before, and then gets **Broken Bones** for 20 seconds.
- A player who is hit sees your GIF play once over their screen as an X-ray: the view dims behind it, their skeleton fills the middle of
  the screen, cracks and then shatters, frame by frame exactly as your GIF times it (12 frames, 2.9 s), with a quick fade in and a fade
  out after the last frame. Only the player who was hit sees it.

**Broken Bones (a new effect, with its own icon: a snapped bone)**
- Slowness I for its whole 20 seconds.
- Every 3 to 6 seconds, at random, the legs give way: a short ragdoll fall, then back up. The first one only comes after the
  ultimate's own stun is over.

Not tested in game: all of the above.
